claims: Will Smith won his first Academy Award for Best Actor at the 2022 Oscars for his role as Richard Williams in King Richard.
Will Smith slapped presenter Chris Rock on stage.
Will Smith has since apologized for the action.
Will Smith's Oscar is the Best Performance by an Actor in a Leading Role (2022) for King Richard.
Will Smith was previously nominated for Best Actor for Ali (2002).
Will Smith was previously nominated for Best Actor for The Pursuit of Happyness (2007).
Will Smith walked on stage and struck Chris Rock after a joke about Jada Pinkett Smith's shaved head.
Will Smith shouted, "Keep my wife's name out your f**king mouth!".
The Academy announced a 10-year ban on Will Smith attending the Oscars or any other Academy events starting April 8, 2022.
Will Smith resigned from the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences following the incident.
Will Smith accepted the award and gave a 5-minute and 20-second acceptance speech.
Will Smith's acceptance speech mentioned the pressure to protect his family.
